node.label: Hyperpigmented papule
node.definition: A papule (circumscribed, solid elevation of skin with no visible fluid, varying in size from a pinhead to less than 10mm in diameter at the widest point) that exhibits increased pigmentation (is darker) compared to the surrounding skin.

evidence.snippet: Metaphyseal chondromatosis with D-2-hydroxyglutaric aciduria: Hyperpigmented papule (frequency HP:0040283) [TAS]
